blocks.text: Credit analysts spend a massive amount of time on data entry and document review. Your credit analysis report template is the center of this work. However, manually moving figures from a balance sheet PDF to Excel is slow. It also increases the risk of transcription errors. You can use Lazur to assist with these repetitive tasks.
How to use your credit analysis report template on Mac

Most analysts work in a mix of Excel and web-based portals. If you are on a Mac, you likely use Citrix or a browser to reach your firm's internal tools. Lazur helps you navigate these environments. When you open your credit analysis report template in Excel, keep your source PDFs open in a separate window.

Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur about a document on your screen. You can ask it to extract specific line items like net income or total liabilities. Lazur provides the answer out loud. You can then type these into your template. This keeps your eyes on the source document and your hands on the keyboard.

You spend hours every week looking for specific covenants or prior deal terms. When you need to find a specific clause in a long PDF, use Lazur's research capability. It works in the background via the Lazur for Chrome extension. It scans your open tabs and returns a summary. This saves you from scrolling through hundreds of pages manually.
Drafting your credit memo with voice

Writing the narrative portion of your credit analysis report template can feel like a chore after a long day of data crunching. Use the fn key to dictate your thoughts. Lazur formats your speech into clean text at your cursor. It works in Word, Outlook, or any other app. Speak naturally about the borrower's risk profile. Lazur turns your spoken points into a professional draft.

Always review your firm's policy on AI tools. Do not upload sensitive client data to public AI services. Lazur runs on your Mac and keeps your history local. It does not use your content to train models.

blocks.text: Common mistakes in credit analysis workflows

items: Relying on manual data entry for large financial datasets.
Failing to standardize the credit analysis report template across the team.
Spending too much time on administrative tasks instead of risk assessment.
Ignoring the potential for voice-based dictation to speed up report writing.

blocks.text: Your day is often fragmented by emails and meetings. To stay productive, group your data-heavy tasks. Use the morning for deep work like spreading financials. Use the afternoon for communication and administrative follow-ups. If you get an email about a missing document, ask Lazur to set a reminder in Apple Reminders. This keeps your focus on the analysis.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my credit analysis report template for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you or answers your questions while you perform the work.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for sensitive financial documents?
faq.answer: Lazur processes your data locally on your Mac. It does not use your screen content or audio to train AI models.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with Windows-only finance apps?
faq.answer: Yes, if you access them via a web browser or a virtual desktop like Citrix on your Mac.
